gen-gf-unkempt-gf-shippori-antique: Unkempt shouts with a hand-cut confidence, its crossbars as heavy as the stems they cross. Shippori Antique is the quieter worker, a sans-serif of open, ladle-like bowls that spends its effort on keeping text easy to follow.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Unkempt brings a loud, hand-built swagger to the top of the page. Shippori Antique B1 sits underneath as a plain sans with daylight in every curve, so the commotion above never crowds the text.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro reads modern and unfussy, its curves left open all through the alphabet. But Unkempt, with no thick-thin pulse to guide it, feels rough and loud beside it, a shout next to a level voice.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-snippet: Snippet looks like bent wire, friendly and wide-mouthed. Unkempt next to it feels rowdier and more forceful, while the body keeps a sans-serif approachability that makes the headline's attitude seem deliberate.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-sour-gummy: Commanding comes first from Unkempt, which punches out its message with no hairlines and almost no stroke contrast. Sour Gummy handles the rest, a sans with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp and tidy.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-special-gothic: Scrappy up top, soft below. Unkempt brings a rough, forceful headline and Special Gothic follows with rounded, open letters, a sans that stays inviting.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-spinnaker: Unkempt carries a forceful, expressive voice, and it has no thick-thin pulse to carry the eye along. Yet Spinnaker keeps its counters connected to the outside space, so a sans-serif paragraph of it flows along without tiring.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-stick: Stick draws tubelike, constant-weight lines with exits wide enough to pass light through. Yet Unkempt's rough, commanding headline is what gives this pairing its punch, and the sans body simply lets it speak.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-suse: SUSE reads approachable and current, its curves as hefty as a rope with open, ladle-like bowls. And Unkempt is the better shouter, while this sans-serif is the better one at carrying sentences after the shouting stops.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-suse-mono: Rough-edged and loud, then tidy and spaced out. Unkempt pours its ink at one width across the headline, while SUSE Mono, a sans-serif, gives every letter extra room.
